apps.localizedDescription:
iCSM:

A personal CSGO port by BILIBILI @SU_ZeShin for iPhone and iPad, running natively on ARM64 with a Metal rendering backend. The game modules, SDL, and Metal backend are built from source. Current version: 0.7.2 (Build 200).

Features added in this port:

• MetalFX spatial upscaling: render the scene at a lower internal resolution and upscale it to the output resolution, using the scene render scale defined by the graphics presets.
• MetalFX frame interpolation: targets 60 rendered frames → 120 displayed frames, with low-latency scheduling, weapon animation protection, and adaptive behavior under load. Requires a supported GPU and a 120 Hz display; actual frame rates depend on the device and scene.

versions.localizedDescription:
iCSM 0.7.2 · Build 200:

Native ARM64 CSGO for iPhone and iPad, with the Metal backend. This release updates the mobile source, personally re-signable IPA, matching data and Ubuntu x86_64 dedicated-server source together.

V2 packaging revision: the data ZIP and volumes have been renamed; resource bytes and data identity are unchanged. The IPA and source ZIPs include V2 file-sharing auto-detection and legacy filename compatibility. Game version remains Build200. Revision source: cd767a77; the original Build200 tag is retained.

• Import the resulting iCSM-v2.zip from the app's initial screen. Do not import individual parts. The resource identity is unchanged, so existing verified data remain compatible.

Changes:

• Restore recoil, view punch, bot weapon handoff and correct weapon kill icons.
• Improve touch aiming/movement, sliders and custom buttons; Xbox-standard mapping and separate stick deadzones.
• Add the available 2019 sticker/glove catalogs, direct sticker replacement and cosmetic/memory optimizations.
• Keep fonts/UI clear independently of scene resolution; first-successful-data-start announcement lasts ten seconds.
• Improve MetalFX motion/occlusion filtering. Add Settings → Video → 插帧性能测试 with repeatable three-map quick / twelve-map full tests, per-device recommendations, explicit apply, cancel and interruption recovery.

The 36-sample quick test on the connected M5 iPad completed without GPU errors. Some high-preset scenes still miss stable 120 FPS; protected weapon animation remains at the native rate. Twelve-map full mode and Build200 iPhone installation were not tested in this update. This is a locally verified release; the full cloud IPA + Data workflow has not been executed. Ubuntu full compilation/linking and all 17 ELF64 x86_64 images/dependencies passed; real Ubuntu deployment/multiplayer gameplay was not run.
